features.title: AI offers checked by domain rules
features.desc: AI proposes the scope, price, and terms. Before anything is saved, business rules check the price range and completeness, so no half-baked proposals go out.

features.title: Reports explained in plain language
features.desc: Profit/loss figures become a short explanation: what went up, what went down, and what needs attention.

features.title: Five-team AI optimization room
features.desc: Creative, marketing, finance, operations, and research work in parallel on your numbers, then one lead draws the conclusion. Made for decisions too big for one head.

features.title: Agent Skill Editor
features.desc: Tune the agent prompt, temperature, and token limit to fit your business. The AI follows how you work, not the other way around.

features.title: WhatsApp & Email connectors
features.desc: Requests come in and offers go out through the channels your customers already use.

income.title: The same work, *more* value.
income.lede: Two menus that add value to every job: find add-on opportunities in your operating data, manage the catalog, then track waste and the savings you've achieved.

engines.title: Sell add-ons without guessing
engines.desc: Satu Alur reads which services you do most often, then shows add-ons that make sense to offer — with price, direct cost, and expected uptake.

engines.title: Plug the leaks, one by one
engines.desc: Idle time, travel, wasted materials, rework, and water and chemicals are all counted in Rupiah. The waste-free score shows real progress, not a feeling.

Fix-it plan ordered from the biggest leak

room.title: Five AI teams, one conclusion
room.desc: Every Revenue menu shares the same workspace: five AI teams read your numbers in parallel, then one lead decides the next step. You pick one of three short briefs — no prompt writing needed.

growth.title: Once you're organized, it's time to *grow*.
growth.lede: The radar and advisor read your workflow data. The lead finder helps you find new customers, Social Media manages your content, and sample recommendations show how to weigh an opportunity.

cards.title: Opportunity radar
cards.desc: Routine services coming due, customers who went quiet, stalled offers, and busy seasons — found in your own transactions, not a purchased list.

cards.title: Recommendations & predictions
cards.desc: Explore sample opportunity scores, estimated value, and win probability. This section uses demo data to show how to read a recommendation.

cards.title: Lead finder
cards.desc: Pick a point and radius on the map and choose a business type. AI scores the fit and prepares the offer. Nothing is sent automatically.

cards.title: Social Media
cards.desc: Write content with AI, schedule it to your connected Facebook, Instagram, or Threads, then request ads or a collaboration from the Satu Alur team.

assistants.title: AI Advisor
assistants.desc: Ask "why did profit drop this month?" and the answer uses numbers from your workflow, not generic guesses. Conversations are stored on your device.
assistants.sample: Profit fell 12% because two travel costs went up and one job hasn't been invoiced yet.

assistants.title: AI Superpowers
assistants.desc: An assistant with a calculator, your business data, and Rupiah formatting — for work that doesn't fit in one form.

growth.note: Connect the platforms you want to use: a Facebook Page, an Instagram Business account linked to a Facebook Page, or a Threads account.

integration.title: Satu Alur *complements* the systems you already run.
integration.lede: No need to throw out the ERP, POS app, or spreadsheets you've used for years. Connect the source, map the columns, then move data over gradually — while both systems keep running side by side.

cards.title: REST API
cards.desc: Connect Odoo, SAP Business One, NetSuite, or internal apps through their existing endpoints. Credentials are stored encrypted.

cards.title: File import
cards.desc: Export CSV or JSON from the old system (Excel can be exported as CSV), map the columns, then check the preview before a single row is written.

cards.title: Inbound webhook
cards.desc: The old system sends events when something changes. Every delivery's signature is verified before it's accepted.

steps.title: Connect
steps.desc: Test the connection first. No data moves until you agree.

steps.title: Map
steps.desc: Match source columns to Satu Alur columns, including Rupiah and Indonesian date formats.

steps.title: Move gradually
steps.desc: Workforce and catalog first, then requests. Rollback keeps rows that have already been edited or used.

integration.note: ERP integration and data migration are available for Enterprise accounts. Parallel running lets both systems be used together during the transition.

roadmap.title: Data model for forecasting
roadmap.desc: Every workflow stage produces structured data. That data becomes the basis for projecting demand, team capacity, and company cash flow ahead.

roadmap.title: Offer parameters
roadmap.desc: Set the base rates, margins, and discount rules the AI uses when drafting offers, so pricing stays consistent across the team.

roadmap.title: Report parameters
roadmap.desc: Choose the metrics, period, and explanation style for reports to match the questions you actually ask about your business.

faqs.q: Where is my business data stored?
faqs.a: Your data is stored in a secure cloud. Every record is tied to your account, so it stays separate from other users.

faqs.q: What are Add-on services and Zero waste?
faqs.a: Two menus in the Revenue group. Add-on services manages a catalog of add-ons sold alongside your existing jobs, complete with price, cost, and expected uptake. Zero waste tracks waste across five streams — time, travel, materials, rework, water and chemicals — in Rupiah, then ranks which is biggest so you can close it first.

faqs.q: Do the Growth features use my customer data?
faqs.a: Yes, and only data from your own account. The opportunity radar reads your own transactions to find routine services coming due or customers who haven't come back. The lead finder uses the point and radius you choose, and never sends messages automatically.

faqs.q: How do I sign in to Satu Alur?
faqs.a: Just with your email. We send a one-time code (OTP) to your address, so there's no password to remember or share.
The app has a Help menu: send a ticket with your question or issue, and the Satu Alur team replies in the same thread. Ticket status is always clear — Open, In progress, or Done.

faqs.q: Which AI is used, and can I trust the results?
faqs.a: Offers and report explanations are written by AI and stream in as they're generated, so you can cancel at any time. Offers always pass domain rule validation before they're saved, and the final decision stays with you.

faqs.q: Can I change how the AI writes offers?
faqs.a: Yes. Settings includes the Agent Skill Editor for changing the agent prompt, temperature, token limit, and model preference.

faqs.q: What are the limits of the free plan?
faqs.a: Under the current draft scheme, the Sole Trader plan is free for 3 months for 1 user and up to 50 transactions per month, including AI offers and basic reports. These numbers may still change.

faqs.q: Is it connected to WhatsApp and email yet?
faqs.a: Not yet. WhatsApp and email connectors are on the roadmap. The connector foundation is already in Settings and will be switched on once the integrations are ready.
